key: ELIAS: Dominus vobiscum.
en: ELIAS: Dominus vobiscum.
ja: イライアス: 主、なんじらとともにあらんことを。

key: So you return.
en: So you return.
ja: あなたは戻られたのですね。

key: Repetita iuvant, but let us hope your conviction is stronger for it.
en: Repetita iuvant, but let us hope your conviction is stronger for it.
ja: Repetita iuvant、しかしそれ以上に、あなたの信念が強くあることを願います。

key: With no time to waste,
en: With no time to waste,
ja: 無駄にする時間はありません、

key: Let us test them at once.
en: Let us test them at once.
ja: すぐに彼らを試してみましょう。

key: Show me the spirit He has placed unto you!
en: Show me the spirit He has placed unto you!
ja: 彼がなんじに授けた精神を、私にお見せください!

key: ELIAS: Descensus in cuniculi cavum...
en: ELIAS: Descensus in cuniculi cavum...
ja: イライアス: Descensus in cuniculi cavum……

key: You go ever-onward through madness and monster alike.
en: You go ever-onward through madness and monster alike.
ja: あなたは常に、狂気と怪物のどちらの中をも突き進んでこられました。

key: I implore you, though with little merit to it, to not think of me now as the latter.
en: I implore you, though with little merit to it, to not think of me now as the latter.
ja: 恐れながらお願いいたします。どうか今の私を、後者だとは思わないでください。

key: As I have failed in my duty, my master has passed.
en: As I have failed in my duty, my master has passed.
ja: 私が務めを果たせなかったことにより、私の師は逝去いたしました。

key: As he has passed, so has my contract.
en: As he has passed, so has my contract.
ja: 師が逝去したことで、私の契約もまた終わりました。

key: Cuiusvis hominis est errare, nullius nisi insipientis in errore perseverare.
en: Cuiusvis hominis est errare, nullius nisi insipientis in errore perseverare.
ja: Cuiusvis hominis est errare, nullius nisi insipientis in errore perseverare。

key: Only a fool persists in his faults.
en: Only a fool persists in his faults.
ja: 愚者だけが、過ちに固執するのです。

key: My loyalty now lies not with mortals, but the Lord.
en: My loyalty now lies not with mortals, but the Lord.
ja: 今、私の忠誠は死すべき者にではなく、主にあります。

key: And even I could not be blind enough to believe that that woman acts in His interest.
en: And even I could not be blind enough to believe that that woman acts in His interest.
ja: そして私でさえ、あの女が彼のご意志のために動いているなどとは、盲目的に信じることはできませんでした。

key: I understand that the one who fares the best against her is you.
en: I understand that the one who fares the best against her is you.
ja: 彼女に対して最も善戦できるのは、あなただと理解しております。

key: You have always had the blessing of power, have you not?
en: You have always had the blessing of power, have you not?
ja: あなたは常に、力の祝福を受けておられましたね?

key: I first heard of how it shone atop Pyrous Mountain.
en: I first heard of how it shone atop Pyrous Mountain.
ja: 最初にそれを耳にしたのは、パイラス山の頂に輝いていたときのことでした。

key: Thus, retribution is a mission I will entrust to you.
en: Thus, retribution is a mission I will entrust to you.
ja: ゆえに、その報いをあなたに委ねることといたします。

key: It is not the only thing.
en: It is not the only thing.
ja: それだけではありません。

key: I wager this against you--
en: I wager this against you--
ja: 私はこれを賭けます――

key: Thus, I wager this against you--
en: Thus, I wager this against you--
ja: ゆえに、私はこれを賭けます――

key: The Emerald Brooch.
en: The Emerald Brooch.
ja: エメラルドブローチを。

key: This artifact of my Lord will choose its own fate.
en: This artifact of my Lord will choose its own fate.
ja: 我が主のこの遺物は、みずからの運命を選ぶことでしょう。

key: Your light...
en: Your light...
ja: あなたの光……

key: My conviction...
en: My conviction...
ja: 私の信念……

key: Let us witness firsthand which His destiny favors!
en: Let us witness firsthand which His destiny favors!
ja: 彼のご意志がどちらに味方するのか、この目で確かめましょう!

key: So be it.
en: So be it.
ja: ……そう　定められていたのだ

key: ELIAS: Virtus tentamine gaudet.
en: ELIAS: Virtus tentamine gaudet.
ja: イライアス: Virtus tentamine gaudet。

key: Yours is a power that grows with defeat.
en: Yours is a power that grows with defeat.
ja: あなたの力は、敗北とともに育つ力です。

key: Against this, even she will not last.
en: Against this, even she will not last.
ja: これに対しては、彼女とてもちこたえられないでしょう。

key: Your way is clear.
en: Your way is clear.
ja: あなたの道は明らかです。

key: ELIAS: Your belief has won this fight.
en: ELIAS: Your belief has won this fight.
ja: イライアス: あなたの信念が、この戦いに勝ちました。

key: I give this freely.
en: I give this freely.
ja: これを心よりお贈りいたします。

key: ELIAS: Let destiny carry you to your true purpose.
en: ELIAS: Let destiny carry you to your true purpose.
ja: イライアス: 運命があなたを、真の目的へと導きますように。

key: That, not even my Lord may predict.
en: That, not even my Lord may predict.
ja: それさえも、我が主にはお見通しにはならないでしょう。

key: I, for one, will pray my daughter lies safely somewhere at the end of it.
en: I, for one, will pray my daughter lies safely somewhere at the end of it.
ja: 私としては、私の娘がその果てのどこかで無事にいることを、ただ祈るばかりです。

key: Until next time, pax vobiscum, and adieu.
en: Until next time, pax vobiscum, and adieu.
ja: またお会いしましょう。pax vobiscum、そしてご機嫌よう。

key: ELIAS: Little have I gained and not lost.
en: ELIAS: Little have I gained and not lost.
ja: イライアス: 私が得たものより、失ったものの方が少なかったとは言えません。

key: Beauty is said to be in the eye of the beholder,
en: Beauty is said to be in the eye of the beholder,
ja: 美とは、見る者の目の中にあると言われますが、

key: But what good is sight without that which one loves to gaze upon?
en: But what good is sight without that which one loves to gaze upon?
ja: 見ることを望む対象がなければ、視力とて何の意味がありましょうか。

key: Even my Lord does not permit me to see Him.
en: Even my Lord does not permit me to see Him.
ja: 我が主でさえ、私に彼を見ることをお許しになりません。

key: Dominus illuminatio mea...
en: Dominus illuminatio mea...
ja: Dominus illuminatio mea……

key: The Lord is my light,
en: The Lord is my light,
ja: 主は我が光なり、

key: But men may not stare into the sun.
en: But men may not stare into the sun.
ja: されど人は太陽を直視できません。

key: Perhaps before the end, I will return the gift I have been granted after all.
en: Perhaps before the end, I will return the gift I have been granted after all.
ja: 終わりが来る前に、いつか私に授けられた贈り物を、お返しすることになるのかもしれません。

key: FLORA: What.
en: FLORA: What.
ja: フローラ: は?

key: Hello, excuse me?
en: Hello, excuse me?
ja: ちょっと、すみません?

key: Do you perhaps speak English?
en: Do you perhaps speak English?
ja: もしかして英語通じます?

key: Or have you not interacted with humans since the age of Garufans?
en: Or have you not interacted with humans since the age of Garufans?
ja: それとも、ガルーファ時代からこのかた人間と関わってないとか?

key: I'd believe you're that old.
en: I'd believe you're that old.
ja: そのくらい老けてても信じるわよ。

key: ELIAS: Ahem.
en: ELIAS: Ahem.
ja: イライアス: ゴホン。

key: I was briefly informed as to the circumstances of your visit, my Lord, but I must admit I find them peculiar.
en: I was briefly informed as to the circumstances of your visit, my Lord, but I must admit I find them peculiar.
ja: 我が主よ、あなたの来訪の事情については簡単にお聞きしておりましたが、正直、いささか奇妙に感じております。

key: FLORA: "My Lord"?
en: FLORA: "My Lord"?
ja: フローラ: 「我が主」?

key: You mean \PN?
en: You mean \PN?
ja: \PNのこと?

key: ELIAS: I do.
en: ELIAS: I do.
ja: イライアス: そうです。

key: FLORA: A "Lord"?
en: FLORA: A "Lord"?
ja: フローラ: 「主」?

key: ELIAS: Yes.
en: ELIAS: Yes.
ja: イライアス: はい。

key: FLORA: Ahahaha-hahahaha!
en: FLORA: Ahahaha-hahahaha!
ja: フローラ: アハハハハハハハ!

key: ELIAS: It is no joke, puella.
en: ELIAS: It is no joke, puella.
ja: イライアス: 冗談ではありません、puella。

key: For as it was told unto me, \PN is the assumed avatar of the Lord Arceus.
en: For as it was told unto me, \PN is the assumed avatar of the Lord Arceus.
ja: 私が聞き及ぶところによれば、\PNは主アルセウスの化身とされております。

key: For all the miracles that He has brought since first He appeared, I believe there can be no reasonable doubt of this.
en: For all the miracles that He has brought since first He appeared, I believe there can be no reasonable doubt of this.
ja: 彼が初めて姿を現されて以来もたらしてきたあらゆる奇跡を思えば、これに合理的な疑いの余地はないと信じております。

key: For it was He who did spare this region from the shadow of a prior threat, and He did bring justice upon the killer of my former master.
en: For it was He who did spare this region from the shadow of a prior threat, and He did bring justice upon the killer of my former master.
ja: この地方をかつての脅威の影から救ったのも彼であり、私の先の師を殺めた者に裁きを下されたのも彼です。

key: And it was He who disappeared when the long fight was over and the Lord Arceus was at last freed from its prison.
en: And it was He who disappeared when the long fight was over and the Lord Arceus was at last freed from its prison.
ja: そして、長い戦いが終わり、主アルセウスがついにその囚われの身から解き放たれたとき、姿を消されたのもまた彼でした。

key: I am only thankful that He came back to us.
en: I am only thankful that He came back to us.
ja: 彼が私たちの元へ戻ってくださったことに、ただ感謝するばかりです。

key: For all the miracles that She has brought since first She appeared, I believe there can be no reasonable doubt of this.
en: For all the miracles that She has brought since first She appeared, I believe there can be no reasonable doubt of this.
ja: 彼女が初めて姿を現されて以来もたらしてきたあらゆる奇跡を思えば、これに合理的な疑いの余地はないと信じております。

key: For it was She who did spare this region from the shadow of a prior threat, and She did bring justice upon the killer of my former master.
en: For it was She who did spare this region from the shadow of a prior threat, and She did bring justice upon the killer of my former master.
ja: この地方をかつての脅威の影から救ったのも彼女であり、私の先の師を殺めた者に裁きを下されたのも彼女です。

key: And it was She who disappeared when the long fight was over and the Lord Arceus was at last freed from its prison.
en: And it was She who disappeared when the long fight was over and the Lord Arceus was at last freed from its prison.
ja: そして、長い戦いが終わり、主アルセウスがついにその囚われの身から解き放たれたとき、姿を消されたのもまた彼女でした。

key: I am only thankful that She came back to us.
en: I am only thankful that She came back to us.
ja: 彼女が私たちの元へ戻ってくださったことに、ただ感謝するばかりです。

key: For all the miracles that They have brought since first They appeared, I believe there can be no reasonable doubt of this.
en: For all the miracles that They have brought since first They appeared, I believe there can be no reasonable doubt of this.
ja: 彼らが初めて姿を現されて以来もたらしてきたあらゆる奇跡を思えば、これに合理的な疑いの余地はないと信じております。

key: For it was They who did spare this region from the shadow of a prior threat, and They did bring justice upon the killer of my former master.
en: For it was They who did spare this region from the shadow of a prior threat, and They did bring justice upon the killer of my former master.
ja: この地方をかつての脅威の影から救ったのも彼らであり、私の先の師を殺めた者に裁きを下されたのも彼らです。

key: And it was They who disappeared when the long fight was over and the Lord Arceus was at last freed from its prison.
en: And it was They who disappeared when the long fight was over and the Lord Arceus was at last freed from its prison.
ja: そして、長い戦いが終わり、主アルセウスがついにその囚われの身から解き放たれたとき、姿を消されたのもまた彼らでした。

key: I am only thankful that They came back to us.
en: I am only thankful that They came back to us.
ja: 彼らが私たちの元へ戻ってくださったことに、ただ感謝するばかりです。

key: FLORA: Wait, you're really not joking?
en: FLORA: Wait, you're really not joking?
ja: フローラ: ちょっと、マジで冗談じゃないの?

key: With people like you around and in charge, there's no wonder this backwards-ass region is such a mess.
en: With people like you around and in charge, there's no wonder this backwards-ass region is such a mess.
ja: あんたみたいなのが権力持ってるから、この地方はこんなポンコツなことになってるのね。

key: \PN, tell him you're not secretly an Arceus or whatever. Seriously.
en: \PN, tell him you're not secretly an Arceus or whatever. Seriously.
ja: \PN、あんたが密かにアルセウスとかじゃないって言ってやってよ。マジで。

key: ELIAS: As your ever-humble servant, it pleases me to know that I am understood and, in the light of your grace, accepted.
en: ELIAS: As your ever-humble servant, it pleases me to know that I am understood and, in the light of your grace, accepted.
ja: イライアス: あなたの謙虚な僕として、理解していただけたこと、そしてあなたの慈悲によって受け入れていただけたことを、うれしく思います。

key: FLORA: You've got to be fucking kidding me.
en: FLORA: You've got to be fucking kidding me.
ja: フローラ: マジふざけてんの。

key: Are you seriously feeding into this?
en: Are you seriously feeding into this?
ja: マジでこの話に乗っかってんの?

key: You must be even more of an egomaniac than I expected.
en: You must be even more of an egomaniac than I expected.
ja: 思ってたよりずっと自ほれ屋なのね。

key: ELIAS: A prank...
en: ELIAS: A prank...
ja: イライアス: いたずら……

key: I have considered this, of course.
en: I have considered this, of course.
ja: もちろん、それも考慮いたしました。

key: However, the evidence is too overwhelming.
en: However, the evidence is too overwhelming.
ja: しかし、証拠があまりにも圧倒的です。

key: The timing could not be coincidental, and what you have, in ending the prior conflict, done for me personally cannot be discounted.
en: The timing could not be coincidental, and what you have, in ending the prior conflict, done for me personally cannot be discounted.
ja: そのタイミングは偶然とは思えませんし、あなたが先の争いを終わらせることで私個人になしてくださったことも、無視することはできません。

key: Therefore, I can only see this moment for what it is--
en: Therefore, I can only see this moment for what it is--
ja: ゆえに、私にはこの瞬間が何であるかは明白です――

key: A test of faith.
en: A test of faith.
ja: 信仰の試練です。

key: Rest assured, my Lord, mine remains ever-steady.
en: Rest assured, my Lord, mine remains ever-steady.
ja: ご安心を、我が主よ。私の信仰は今も揺るぎません。

key: FLORA: Are you fucking kidding me?
en: FLORA: Are you fucking kidding me?
ja: フローラ: マジでふざけてんの?

key: Hello? Earth to resident living relic???
en: Hello? Earth to resident living relic???
ja: もしもし? 生きた遺物のあんたに地球から呼びかけてるんだけど???

key: IT'S NOT REAL.
en: IT'S NOT REAL.
ja: 現実じゃないから。

key: \PN is just another person.
en: \PN is just another person.
ja: \PNはただの人間よ。

key: ELIAS: In order to call oneself a true believer, one must have unshakeable faith.
en: ELIAS: In order to call oneself a true believer, one must have unshakeable faith.
ja: イライアス: 真の信者を名乗るには、揺るぎない信仰を持たねばなりません。

key: I am afraid that your tricks will not deceive me.
en: I am afraid that your tricks will not deceive me.
ja: あなたの策略に、私はだまされません。

key: FLORA: I'm going to jump out one of those pretty stained glass windows.
en: FLORA: I'm going to jump out one of those pretty stained glass windows.
ja: フローラ: あのステンドグラスの窓から飛び降りてやろうかしら。

key: ELIAS: Though I cannot help but feel this command is in response to my prior opposition in servitude to my former master,
en: ELIAS: Though I cannot help but feel this command is in response to my prior opposition in servitude to my former master,
ja: イライアス: この命令は、先の師への奉仕において私が示した抵抗への返答であるように感じずにはいられませんが、

key: As I am your willing vessel and servant, my Lord, so it shall be done.
en: As I am your willing vessel and servant, my Lord, so it shall be done.
ja: 私はあなたの喜んで仕える器であり僕ですから、我が主よ、そのようにいたしましょう。

key: ELIAS: My loyalty and faith is yours now and ever- forward.
en: ELIAS: My loyalty and faith is yours now and ever- forward.
ja: イライアス: 私の忠誠と信仰は、今このときより永遠にあなたのものです。

key: FLORA: BAHAHAH!!!
en: FLORA: BAHAHAH!!!
ja: フローラ: ばあーっはっはっは!!!

key: Ahahahaha-hahahahahaha!!!
en: Ahahahaha-hahahahahaha!!!
ja: アハハハハ、ハハハハハハハ!!!

key: FLORA: Okay, \PN, that was a good one.
en: FLORA: Okay, \PN, that was a good one.
ja: フローラ: オーケー、\PN、今のは面白かったわ。

key: But seriously, if we keep on with this any more, you're gonna see last night's dinner all over the floor, and nobody wants that.
en: But seriously, if we keep on with this any more, you're gonna see last night's dinner all over the floor, and nobody wants that.
ja: でもマジで、これ以上続けたら、床に昨夜の夕食がぶちまけられるとこ見ることになるわよ、誰もそんなの見たくないでしょ。

key: ELIAS: Regardless, though I may be in your care and servitude, I am tasked with another role here.
en: ELIAS: Regardless, though I may be in your care and servitude, I am tasked with another role here.
ja: イライアス: それでも、あなたのかば護と奉仕のもとにあるとはいえ、私はここでもう一つの役目を負っております。

key: Regardless, though I may be in your care and servitude, I am tasked with another role here.
en: Regardless, though I may be in your care and servitude, I am tasked with another role here.
ja: それでも、あなたのかば護と奉仕のもとにあるとはいえ、私はここでもう一つの役目を負っております。

key: It would be remiss of me to not oppose you within these halls merely on the basis of my support for you.
en: It would be remiss of me to not oppose you within these halls merely on the basis of my support for you.
ja: あなたへの支持だけを理由に、この殿堂の中であなたに立ち向かわないでいるのは、怠慢というものでしょう。

key: After all, if it were not what you wished, you would not have willed me to be here.
en: After all, if it were not what you wished, you would not have willed me to be here.
ja: 結局のところ、あなたがそれを望まれなかったなら、私をここに配置しようとはお考えにならなかったはずですから。

key: FLORA: ...That logic doesn't even make sense.
en: FLORA: ...That logic doesn't even make sense.
ja: フローラ: …その理屈、全然筋通ってないんだけど。

key: You could just use that to justify whatever bullshit power you wanted to do.
en: You could just use that to justify whatever bullshit power you wanted to do.
ja: それじゃ、あんたがやりたいクソみたいな権力行使を何でも正当化できちゃうじゃない。

key: In fact, that's not even hypothetical-- isn't that exactly what every major religious organization has done for centuries?!
en: In fact, that's not even hypothetical-- isn't that exactly what every major religious organization has done for centuries?!
ja: てか、それって別に仮の話でもなくて――何世紀もの間、あらゆる主要な宗教組織がやってきたことそのものじゃない?!

key: People like you are the reason that so many have suffered under systems of oppression!
en: People like you are the reason that so many have suffered under systems of oppression!
ja: あんたみたいな連中がいるから、抑圧のシステムの下でこんなに多くの人が苦しんできたのよ!

key: \PN, I've heard enough of this.
en: \PN, I've heard enough of this.
ja: \PN、もう聞いてらんない。

key: Let's help grandpa back into his grave!
en: Let's help grandpa back into his grave!
ja: じいさんを墓に送り返すの手伝ってよ!

key: FLORA: ...\PN.
en: FLORA: ...\PN.
ja: フローラ: …\PN。

key: How did you come all the way here and not even bring a full team to fight with?
en: How did you come all the way here and not even bring a full team to fight with?
ja: ここまで来といて、フルパーティすら連れてきてないってどういうこと?

key: Do you WANT me to lose?
en: Do you WANT me to lose?
ja: あたしに負けてほしいわけ?

key: (Seriously, how did this moron ever get to be champion...)
en: (Seriously, how did this moron ever get to be champion...)
ja: （マジで、この馬鹿がどうやってチャンピオンになったわけ……）

key: Go back and get some actual goddamn Pokémon before I lose my fucking patience already!
en: Go back and get some actual goddamn Pokémon before I lose my fucking patience already!
ja: 戻ってちゃんとポケモン連れてきなさいよ、あたしの我慢が切れる前にね!

key: FLORA: Hey, \PN?
en: FLORA: Hey, \PN?
ja: フローラ: ねえ、\PN?

key: What are you doing?
en: What are you doing?
ja: 何やってるの?

key: Did you perhaps somehow manage to forget that you need to PICK SOME POKÉMON?!
en: Did you perhaps somehow manage to forget that you need to PICK SOME POKÉMON?!
ja: もしかして、ポケモンを選ぶ必要があるのを忘れちゃったとか?!

key: I am honored to permit your victory, my Lord.
en: I am honored to permit your victory, my Lord.
ja: あなたの勝利を　この手で認められること　光栄に存じます　わが主よ

key: I am made whole again, and you may proceed onwards with purpose divine.
en: I am made whole again, and you may proceed onwards with purpose divine.
ja: 私は再び完全な姿を取り戻しました。あなたは神聖な目的とともに、先へお進みください。

key: FLORA: Great, I'm getting out of here yesterday.
en: FLORA: Great, I'm getting out of here yesterday.
ja: フローラ: よし、あたし昨日のうちにここを出てるわ。

key: ELIAS: It is, and always will be, my pleasure to serve in the cause of the Lord.
en: ELIAS: It is, and always will be, my pleasure to serve in the cause of the Lord.
ja: イライアス: 主のご意志に仕えることは、今も、これからも、私の喜びです。

key: You grace me again with your presence on this day, my Lord.
en: You grace me again with your presence on this day, my Lord.
ja: 今日もまた、あなたの御前に立てることを光栄に思います。

key: As always, I am ever-grateful to hold a moment of your time.
en: As always, I am ever-grateful to hold a moment of your time.
ja: いつものように、あなたのお時間をいただけることに、心より感謝いたします。

key: It is my pleasure to be considered an opponent worthy of you.
en: It is my pleasure to be considered an opponent worthy of you.
ja: あなたにふさわしい相手として見なしていただけること、光栄に存じます。

key: Even in defeat, it is an honor to bear witness to your divine light.
en: Even in defeat, it is an honor to bear witness to your divine light.
ja: 敗れてなお　その神聖なる光を　この目で見届けられたことは　誉れである

key: As expected.
en: As expected.
ja: 予想通りです。

key: Your power and grace remain ever-radiant, my Lord.
en: Your power and grace remain ever-radiant, my Lord.
ja: あなたの力と気品は、今も変わらず輝いておられますね、我が主よ。

key: Your skills are unmatched, even in this form.
en: Your skills are unmatched, even in this form.
ja: この姿にあっても、あなたの技術は比類ありません。

key: I do hope that if you desire to sharpen them further, I may be granted the privilege to be your opponent once more.
en: I do hope that if you desire to sharpen them further, I may be granted the privilege to be your opponent once more.
ja: もしさらに腕を磨きたいとお望みでしたら、再びあなたの相手を務める栄誉をいただければと願っております。

key: ELIAS: Your power and grace remain ever- radiant, my Lord.
en: ELIAS: Your power and grace remain ever- radiant, my Lord.
ja: イライアス: あなたの力と気品は、今も変わらず輝いておられますね、我が主よ。

key: I do hope that if you desire to sharpen your skills further, I may be granted the privilege to be your opponent once more.
en: I do hope that if you desire to sharpen your skills further, I may be granted the privilege to be your opponent once more.
ja: もしさらに技術を磨きたいとお望みでしたら、再びあなたの相手を務める栄誉をいただければと願っております。

key: You honor me
en: You honor me
ja: 光栄です

key: It's just a prank
en: It's just a prank
ja: ただのいたずらです

key: Bow before me
en: Bow before me
ja: ひれ伏せ
